ops.title: Wire internal/kg into a cc-notes kg CLI surface
ops.description:
Phases 1-3 landed as library packages — `internal/kg`, `internal/kg/rank`,
`internal/kg/stale` — plus throwaway internal main harnesses under `cmd/kgeval`,
`cmd/kgrank`, `cmd/kgstale`. **There is no `cc-notes kg` command.**

This is why `task done` refuses `d173a7f`, `1e06af0` and `c115b94`: their
acceptance criteria name `cc-notes kg stat`, `kg stale --explain`, and per-result
lane attribution surfaced through `--explain`. The gate is right and the phases
are genuinely not finished.

The throwaway `cmd/` harnesses are the reference for what each already computes.

Blocks Phase 4 (`4fe7b3a`) — the hooks shell out to this surface.

Adding any MCP mirror means six edits, not five: the five guards in note `566a6b26`
plus the hardcoded tool count in `plugin/capt-hook/hooks/tests/test_cc_notes.py`.

ops.text: cc-notes kg build writes the persisted index and reports node/edge counts
cc-notes kg stat reports node and edge counts by kind
cc-notes kg query --explain shows per-result lane attribution
cc-notes kg stale --explain names the triggering signal per entity
cc-notes kg inject --tier enforces its token budget as a hard cap
Any MCP mirror updates all six trip-wires, the hardcoded count in test_cc_notes.py included
